additional_info.subject: Handover from NOC TO L3
additional_info.body:
Hi All,
This is an escalation case, where customer is reporting of Charging issue with e-Golf.
The asset is Out of warranty since 8th mar 2024.
Here is the issue reported by customer :
2 malfunctions were occurring in Kupferzell in connection with the E-Golf:
(a) The AC charging power is limited to 1.4KW
b) Fast charging is not working.
I was there again today and the fault has still not been rectified. I then had the following result at the e-charging station at KACO:
(a) AC charging power is limited to 1.4KW (was NOT before)
b) Fast charging only works on the 80KW connection.
Since the case was escalated to CS management I am handing over the case to ES team.
Please discuss it with Michele, Rui, Afonso, on the way forward approach and offering support to RC -DE

additional_info.subject: Verification from PrChamp
additional_info.body:
The timestamps provided in the ticket don’t refer to any logged charging session: please provide valid timestamps/description of symptoms.
Please keep in mind that the issue with eGolf 2015 has only been reported by the Customer Regiopower GmbH. No other interoperability issues related to low charging power with eGolf have been observed in the last 2 years, therefore it must be thoroughly investigated by ES to confirm the entity of failures.
Product Care team will be involved
only
if the systematic nature of the problem will be confirmed.
From ES side, we are looking forward to see these cases reported accordingly in order to analyze them.
